verdict.rationale: The synchronous transcribe endpoint documents explicit limits: a single file of up to 100 MB and two hours. That satisfies the 'documented maximum' half of the story. However, two hours is a hard ceiling, so recordings longer than that are not shown to be accepted in a single job. Batch mode handles up to 10,000 files per job, but the evidence documents no per-file duration or size limits for it. Missing for 10: support for recordings longer than two hours in one job, documented per-file duration/size limits for batch mode, independent corroboration of the limits.
